cloudgate_fixture.how: Recorded by `tofu output -json` from a real apply in the live Google Cloud project on 2026-11-06 (a walk by hand; OpenTofu 1.13.1, hashicorp/google 8.8.0), then rewritten to the stored files' sample ids (cloud_1, env_1, svc_1, svc_pg_1, svc_redis_1 and their states, project example-project-123 / 123456789012, region europe-west1, deployment ids dep_N) and with every secret value masked (the default certificate's key, the database password, the wired variables' URLs; the typed variable values were the stored files' sample strings).
